instruction:

1. Create a variable called 'greeting' with value 'Hello World'
2. Display it in the console

success.title: 🎉 Excellent! Your First JavaScript!
success.details: You've successfully created a variable and logged it to the console! This is the foundation of JavaScript programming. You're now ready to build more complex programs!

error.details:
